name: @chroma/inspector
description: Chroma Global Inspector shared chrome (D-103, Phase 4 of docs/notes/global-inspector.md). Tiny, presentation-only primitives (empty state, section heading) shared between @chroma/motion's InspectorPanel and @chroma/editor's ClipInspectorPanel — no @chroma/ui dependency (packages/motion can't use that barrel, see Button.tsx's doc comment), no Tauri, no tab-specific imports, so neither tab package depends on the other.
